findings.title: The no-argument passkey predicate does not exist
findings.body: This call cannot compile: `UsernameForm` inherits only `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel)` from `UsernamePasswordForm`, and neither this class nor its other superclass declares a no-argument overload. The services module and its tests will fail compilation until the call supplies the user or uses a declared method.

findings.title: Fresh logins no longer initialize conditional passkeys
findings.body: This predicate returns false when `context.getUser()` is null, which is the normal state on the initial login page. Consequently `fillContextForm` is not called and the form is rendered without the WebAuthn challenge and conditional-UI attributes needed to start a discoverable passkey login. The previous code initialized those attributes for this no-user case; the re-authentication support should not remove that path.
